title: Use My Workspace
summary: Tour the day's schedule and the patient panel: alerts, record, clinical sessions, odontogram, prescription and AI agent.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Today's schedule
steps.details: Your appointments today in time order, with their status. It refreshes every minute on its own and lets you know when a new appointment comes in or one changes.

steps.title: Refresh
steps.details: Brings in the changes right away, without waiting for the automatic refresh.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Patient in focus
steps.details: Everything about this patient without leaving the appointment: alerts, record, clinical sessions and odontogram.

steps.title: Patient alerts
steps.details: Recorded allergies and ailments. If it blinks, they have alerts worth reviewing before seeing them.

steps.title: Patient record
steps.details: Opens the full record: details, clinical history, quotes, invoices and appointments.

steps.title: Clinical sessions
steps.details: The timeline with the previous sessions; the most recent one shows open to review before seeing the patient.

steps.title: Odontogram
steps.details: The status of each tooth and the marked treatments.

steps.title: Complete clinical session
steps.details: Records what was done today. When saved, the appointment becomes Completed. Only one session per patient per day and from the day of the appointment.

steps.title: Prescribe
steps.details: Builds the prescription with medications, dose and frequency, and prints it with your signature.

steps.title: Clinical agent
steps.details: Ask it about the last procedure, what's due today or the alerts; it can prepare the session or the odontogram for you to review.
